notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, held at 0.6 rather than 0.15 because its blends are drawn approximately; the revised one is the same part, since the beam bores already clear the T-1 package. The reference is the mesh as repaired in place: a 0.13 mm skin of the shell that the CAD left inside the pocket is cut away. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
